shipped_summary: v3.10.0 — 195 commits since v3.9.23. Three themes: the analyser understands what you give it, the product remembers you, and the whole app finally looks like one product.

Intake — one box takes a pitch deck (PDF/DOCX/PPTX, OCR fallback), a URL (multi-page crawl), or free text. A classifier routes it, stage is detected, and only the agents that matter at that stage run.
Persistence — every analysis is saved against an anonymous key and claimed on signup/login. Before this, a founder's result ceased to exist the moment they navigated.

Signup gate — the first run in 30 days is free and unwalled; from the second we ask for an email BEFORE running, so no model spend is burned on a visitor who bounces. The A$3 guest path is unaffected.

Data room — /api/investor-data-room rewritten against the real schema (it had never worked; it inserted five non-existent columns). Investors open a real page at /s/dr/<token>; bad tokens 404. Generated rooms now carry real content, and what the platform cannot produce is marked honestly as missing.
Design system rev.2 → rev.4 — light-first across marketing, dashboard, workspace and admin. The lux dark theme is retired from all 34 marketing pages. pa11y WCAG2AA 26/26.
Homepage rebuilt to show the product's own output — valuation intervals, an eight-dimension radar, the twelve-phase journey, data-room completeness — instead of describing it in prose.
Pricing — A$29 Founder / A$69 Growth / +A$59 Equity add-on; A$299 Pro retired (it exceeded JPMorgan Workplace Solutions at A$277). Credit grants right-sized to hold ≥70% gross margin at full burn.
Correctness — 'pre-revenue' no longer matched the substring 'revenue', which had been pricing a two-founder pre-revenue startup as Series A at A$37.3M.
Privacy — scores.investor_visible (default false) now gates investor deal flow, which had been surfacing 18 founders' company names and scores without consent.

Billing integrity — three places that charged for nothing were closed: the A$59 add-on (sale suspended until entitlements resolve), /api/data-room/generate (charged 3 credits and discarded the result), and Stripe prices that billed Starter A$29 as A$99 and Pro A$299 as A$499.
Compliance — the site claimed GST-exclusive pricing while every Stripe price is tax_behavior=inclusive, including in FAQ JSON-LD that Google indexes.

notes: The defects that mattered most this release were not found by reading code — they surfaced by running the product and looking at screenshots: white-on-white headings, an invisible SVI numeral on the dashboard, invisible form labels on /submit, a data room of 34 documents marked complete with no content behind them, and a share button that had returned 500 on every call since it was written.
